characters.prompt: Create ONE single photorealistic cinematic film still in 16:9 widescreen — one frame only, NOT a grid, no panels, no borders, no captions. REAL PHOTOGRAPH of a real Japanese woman, NOT anime, NOT 3D. Reference image 1 is the channel's APPROVED host: reproduce exactly this woman's FACE, age and skin (identity). Reference image 2 shows the exact hair, dress, earrings and studio of THIS episode: keep them identical. NEW LOOK for this episode (do NOT copy her old hair, clip or top; different from previous episodes' chignon/cardigan, half-up/sage-green and long-straight/navy-blazer): her dark-brown hair is styled in soft, glossy loose waves falling over one shoulder with a gentle side part and a few face-framing strands; she wears an elegant deep wine-red fine-knit dress with a modest round neckline and a slim cream-colored ribbon belt, small pearl drop earrings, a delicate thin gold bracelet; polished natural makeup with a soft coral lip, poised, graceful and radiant — the most beautiful she has looked on this channel. The same bright living-room studio with the beige sofa, wooden shelf and green plant, warm evening window light with a soft golden rim light on her hair, softly out of focus. FRAMING FIRST — TIGHT chest-up close-up: her face fills about ONE THIRD of the frame height, head near the top of the frame, shoulders cut at the bottom edge, NOT a waist-up shot. She faces the camera directly with a calm, warm, composed expression and a small closed-mouth smile (speech is added later), 85mm lens f/2. Both eyes sharp and symmetrical, natural five-fingered hands, no glasses. Full-frame 16:9, no black bars. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or symbols anywhere.
